why_ai: Value rests on permitted physical locations, crews who climb structures and local sales relationships; AI cannot substitute a scarce permitted face.
why_clarity: A face posted on date is checkable and periods recur, but whether a board worked for the advertiser is rarely measured.
why_digital: Work starts from land, leases and steel and ends in a physical display; national buying is increasingly remote and programmatic.

why_ai: Choosing which face to convert is a high-stakes location judgement, and construction and permitting stay on site.
why_clarity: Post-conversion revenue is measurable within a year, but conversions are tens per market and each site differs.
why_digital: Site data and billing feed the decision, but the output is a physical screen built and permitted locally.

why_ai: Multi-year guarantee bids are rare, adversarial and consequential, and won partly on relationships with authorities.
why_clarity: Bid outcomes play out over seven to ten years and each concession is structured differently.
why_digital: Forecasts are modelled on screens, but the concession is won in public procurement and delivered as physical screens in stations and terminals.

why_ai: Keeping locations depends on landowner and planning relationships and adversarial negotiation over irreplaceable sites.
why_clarity: Lease terms are documented, but each negotiation and hearing is different and losses surface years later.
why_digital: The work runs on paper leases, land, council meetings and face-to-face dealings with landowners.

why_ai: Renewals turn on the landowner relationship and on beating aggregators to the conversation.
why_clarity: Rents, terms and renewal outcomes are measurable and recur across tens of thousands of leases.
why_digital: Lease data is digitisable, but the negotiation happens in person or by phone with local landowners.

why_ai: Entitlement fights are novel, adversarial and handled by land-use counsel and senior managers before councils.
why_clarity: Codes are written down, but each jurisdiction and hearing differs and results arrive slowly.
why_digital: Codes and applications are documents, but approvals are won locally before planning bodies.

why_ai: Crews climb structures and install vinyl by hand in all weather; no software substitutes that.
why_clarity: The right creative on the right face by the start date is an instant pass or fail, repeated thousands of times.
why_digital: Physical structures, physical materials and on-site labour from start to finish.

why_ai: Small plants run on the owner's local relationships and knowledge of every face, plus physical posting.
why_clarity: Back-office tasks are routine, but pricing and renewals rest on the owner's feel with little feedback.
why_digital: Inventory is physical and sold locally; digital listing and programmatic reach are still thin.

why_ai: Local accounts are won and kept by the account executive's relationship with the business owner.
why_clarity: Renewals recur yearly, but whether the board drove customers is rarely measured objectively.
why_digital: Proposals and reports are digital, but the product is a physical board sold through local meetings.

why_ai: Loop scheduling and rule checks are rule-bound screen work that automation absorbs.
why_clarity: Each slot either holds a sold, compliant creative or it doesn't, thousands of times a week.
why_digital: Creatives, schedules and programmatic demand are all digital; only the screen is physical.

why_ai: Turning briefs into costed plans is repeatable screen work that language models and optimisers can do.
why_clarity: Each RFP is the same task with new inputs, and win or loss is known within weeks.
why_digital: Briefs, inventory, audience data and responses are all digital and exchanged remotely with agencies.

why_ai: Model-built data products with no licence or physical work; durability depends on owning calibrated history.
why_clarity: Volume estimates can be checked against counters, and releases recur on a schedule.
why_digital: Device and vehicle feeds in, data products out, sold remotely.

why_ai: Survey and panel fieldwork and accredited methodology need people, and bureaus pay for a trusted contractor.
why_clarity: Methods are codified and releases recur, but there is no ground truth to validate audience estimates against.
why_digital: Mostly survey, device and model work on screens, delivered as datasets to a national bureau.

why_ai: An industry-governed currency survives on trust and neutrality rather than on physical work.
why_clarity: The dataset is a defined annual deliverable from a written method, but impressions are never checked against observed looks.
why_digital: Licensed mobility data and inventory records in, a planning dataset out, used by members remotely.

why_ai: Attribution from licensed device panels is screen work that platforms and AI-native tools can replicate.
why_clarity: Studies are repeatable in shape, but causal results for a static face rest on modelled exposure.
why_digital: Device data in, reports out, sold and delivered remotely.

why_ai: Planning and negotiation rest on agency relationships with operators and advertisers; posting audits need site checks.
why_clarity: Plans and buys recur by campaign, and posting compliance is checkable, but plan quality is debated.
why_digital: Planning and buying happen on screens; audits and some negotiations still need presence.

why_ai: Auction and yield software with no licence; further automation absorbs the human roles.
why_clarity: Millions of identical auctions, but impression values depend on modelled audiences.
why_digital: Entirely digital marketplaces operated and sold remotely.

why_ai: Internal analysts supporting sales; durable only where tied to the operator's proprietary face data.
why_clarity: Collateral and plans recur, but their effect on sales is hard to isolate.
why_digital: Data work on screens, delivered to internal sellers and agencies digitally.

why_ai: Underwriting is screen work; landowner acquisition still depends on outreach and trust.
why_clarity: Purchase terms are exact and deals repeat, but returns are known only over years of renewals.
why_digital: Lease data and models on screens; landowners are reached by mail, phone and local visits.

why_ai: Field inspection and legally binding permit decisions by an accountable public agency.
why_clarity: Permits follow written rules and recur annually, with compliance checkable on inspection.
why_digital: Permit records are digital, but the subject is physical structures inspected in the field.

why_ai: The product is manufactured hardware installed on structures.
why_clarity: Displays have exact specifications and pass or fail testing.
why_digital: Physical manufacturing and installation sold through dealer and direct sales relationships.

why_ai: Licensed appraisers sign valuations and testify under adversarial cross-examination.
why_clarity: Approaches are codified, but states disagree on method and outcomes depend on courts.
why_digital: Analysis and reports are digital, but site inspection and testimony are in person.

why_ai: Sellers hire a broker they trust with a private, high-stakes, one-off transaction.
why_clarity: Each plant sale is different and success is judged by price and close, years apart.
why_digital: Valuation work is on screens; deals are made through relationships and meetings.

why_ai: Member-funded research and advocacy with no licence; value is the industry's collective voice.
why_clarity: Revenue reports recur quarterly, but research summaries have no objective test.
why_digital: Member data in, reports and briefs out, distributed digitally.

why_ai: Public officials make legally binding land-use decisions before elected bodies.
why_clarity: Codes are written, but applications and amendments are political and case by case.
why_digital: Codes and files are documents; decisions are made locally in public hearings.

why_ai: Airports and transit agencies hire trusted advisers for infrequent, high-value solicitations.
why_clarity: Solicitation structures follow patterns, but each award is rare and plays out over years.
why_digital: Analysis and documents are digital; engagements involve on-site meetings with authorities.

why_ai: Licensed engineers stamp designs and inspect structures in person.
why_clarity: Wind-load design and inspection follow codes with checkable results.
why_digital: Design is on screens, but inspection and the structures themselves are physical and local.
